scientific_conclusion: Fails original HARPS raw/native correspondence threshold (rho = 0.7807 < 0.8 in D018); absent at comparable strength in March 2021 HARPS control epochs; FEROS 2019 shows sign-flipping absorption-structured continuum across background models, exact inter-order Fe I 6546.238 A calibration consistency between HDU 29 and HDU 30, and proves that the 1.45 km/s D075 single-sideband spread is driven by atmospheric H2O 6552.629 A + blaze tilt rather than wavelength misregistration.

Single-epoch March 9, 2021 HARPS event absent in March 3/4/5/6 controls; exhibits pronounced 2D cross-dispersion spatial profile deviation where outer-row flux is dominated by single neighboring sample k2573 (~5,380 ADU shift between NEAREST and CEIL windows in D063, characteristic of an oblique cosmic-ray / local CCD charge deposition rather than a clean stellar fiber-PSF); blue HARPS COMB response unvalidated (D036); FEROS 2019 HDU 17 Ni I 4829.023 A confirms stellar rest-frame wavelength (4826.10 A) sits on ordinary photospheric absorption structure that flips sign across backgrounds.

Single-epoch September 9, 2021 HARPS event absent in September 6 and 18 controls; exhibits 2D detector-row residual excess (60.9-65.3 ADU RMS in D055-D056, 4.9-5.6x reference median) incompatible with a validated stellar fiber-PSF laser model; FEROS 2019 HDU 24 & 25 show sub-0.1 km/s inter-order wavelength agreement on V I 5727.048 and Fe I 5731.762/5732.296 A and sign-flipping 5-epoch coadd contrasts at stellar rest-frame wavelength 5730.07 A.
